package io.github.xyz1001.pdsync.android;

import java.io.IOException;

public class MainActivity {
    enum SyncPage { DISCOVERY, HOME }
    enum DiagnosticAction { ACCESS_CHECK }
    enum OnboardingProgress { PENDING }
    interface Task<T> { T run() throws Exception; }
    interface SetupDone<T> { void accept(MainActivity owner, T value) throws Exception; }
    static final class Text { String text() { return "message"; } }
    static final Text REQUESTING_ROOT_ACCESS_14 = new Text(), ROOT_ACCESS_WAS_NOT_GRANTED_RETRY_15 = new Text(), CHECK_THE_SELECTED_GAME_265 = new Text();
    static final class BridgeDiagnostics {
        enum Stage { SAVE_READINESS }
        static final class Failure extends IOException {
            Failure(Stage stage, String code, String text, Throwable cause) { super(code, cause); }
        }
    }
    static final class RootSetupAuthorization {
        static int calls; static boolean fail;
        static void probe(Object context, String name) throws IOException {
            calls++; if (fail) throw new IOException("ROOT_DENIED_OR_EXITED");
        }
    }
    static final class GameModeChoice { enum Mode { ROOT, APK } Object request; Object pending() { return request; } }
    static final class SetupSession { final GameSetupFlow flow = new GameSetupFlow(); final GameModeChoice modeChoice = new GameModeChoice(); MainActivity owner; }
    static final class Installer { boolean active; boolean hasActiveRequest() { return active; } }
    final SetupSession setupSession = new SetupSession();
    final Installer installer = new Installer();
    boolean resumed = true, busy, destroyed, recovery, onboardingActive, draftLoaded;
    Object rootGame = new Object(), localPreview, setupOutcome;
    SyncPage page = SyncPage.HOME;
    OnboardingProgress progress;
    String notice;
    MainActivity() { setupSession.owner = this; }
    GameModeChoice.Mode accessMode = GameModeChoice.Mode.ROOT;
    GameModeChoice.Mode currentAccessMode() { return accessMode; }
    Task<?> queued;
    SetupDone<Object> done;
    long generation; String target;
    boolean isDestroyed() { return destroyed; }
    boolean restoreNeedsAttention() { return recovery; }
    Object getApplicationContext() { return this; }
    String selectedGamePackage() { return setupSession.flow.target(); }
    void resetPathPreview() { }
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") <T> void setupWork(DiagnosticAction action, String message, Task<T> work, SetupDone<T> callback) {
        generation = setupSession.flow.generation(); target = setupSession.flow.target();
        queued = work; done = (SetupDone<Object>) callback;
    }
    void finish() throws Exception {
        Task<?> work = queued; queued = null;
        try { Object result = work.run(); if (setupSession.flow.matches(generation, target)) done.accept(this, result); }
        catch (IOException expected) { }
    }
    static void require(boolean condition, String message) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message); }
    /* PRODUCTION_METHODS */
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.setupSession.flow.select("game.one");
        a.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null);
        require(a.queued != null, "saved root target: explicit reentry must schedule probe");
        require(!a.setupSession.flow.rootAuthorized(), "must not authorize before probe");
        a.finish(); require(a.setupSession.flow.rootAuthorized(), "successful probe must authorize");
        MainActivity b = new MainActivity(); b.setupSession.flow.select("game.one"); RootSetupAuthorization.fail = true;
        b.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null); b.finish();
        require(!b.setupSession.flow.rootAuthorized(), "failed probe must not authorize"); RootSetupAuthorization.fail = false;
        MainActivity c = new MainActivity(); c.setupSession.flow.select("game.one");
        c.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null); c.setupSession.flow.select("game.two"); c.finish();
        require(!c.setupSession.flow.rootAuthorized(), "stale result must not authorize new target");
        MainActivity d = new MainActivity(); d.setupSession.flow.select("game.one"); d.recovery = true;
        d.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null); require(d.queued == null, "recovery must block probe");
        MainActivity e = new MainActivity(); e.setupSession.flow.select("game.one"); e.installer.active = true;
        e.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null); require(e.queued == null, "installation must block probe");
        MainActivity f = new MainActivity(); f.setupSession.flow.select("game.one"); f.resumed = false;
        f.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null); require(f.queued == null, "background must not probe");
        MainActivity g = new MainActivity(); g.setupSession.flow.select("game.one");
        g.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.HOME, null); require(g.queued == null, "non-discovery entry must not probe");
        MainActivity h = new MainActivity(); h.setupSession.flow.select("game.one"); h.setupSession.modeChoice.request = new Object();
        h.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null); require(h.queued == null, "pending/cancelable choice must not probe");
        MainActivity i = new MainActivity(); i.setupSession.flow.select("game.one"); i.accessMode = GameModeChoice.Mode.APK;
        i.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null); require(i.queued == null, "APK mode must not probe");
        MainActivity j = new MainActivity(); j.setupSession.flow.select("game.one"); j.setupSession.owner = null;
        j.m20xb2d4905(SyncPage.DISCOVERY, null); require(j.queued == null, "detached owner must not probe");
        System.out.println("root reentry host checks passed");
    }
}
